section0IntroHtml:
🌱 Welcome to the Arduino plant workshop!

Today we will learn how to build an automatic watering system with Arduino. Using this microcontroller, we will read a moisture sensor and control a pump so that our plants get water at exactly the right time.

What you will learn:

  • How to read sensors (measure moisture in the soil)
  • How to control electrical devices (switch pump on/off)
  • How to combine both parts (automatic watering)

Note: We are using Arduino, a platform that makes it easy to control hardware with code. No worries if you have never programmed before — we start from the very beginning! You can choose between a beginner mode with drag-and-drop code blocks and an advanced mode where you fill in code gaps yourself.
section0SafetyHtml:
Safety notes

  • Water and electricity: Make sure no electrical parts (except the sensor) come into contact with water.
  • Power supply: Use only the provided power supplies and voltage levels.
  • If you have problems or are unsure: Always ask for help.
